bfb_record_note: the job's comparison (.bfb.json) and health (.health.json) files of the failed run are kept with this record
what: The capture of 7451996 (with the cloud-borne aerosol fields) replayed through both block slots of the cloud stage's Python driver.
outcome: as 7451924: steps 1 and 2 exported bit-for-bit, the coupler export differed at step 3 on every rank (BoundaryReplayError on cam_out.a2x_rattr, differences of order 1e-15) and the run stopped
diagnosis: the driver's views of the time-rotated buffer fields (CLD, AST, CONCLD, CLDO, the in-cloud water and its old-time copies, CLDFSNOW) were taken once a chunk and kept, while CAM moves the older plane every step; on even steps the capture recorded, and the replay wrote, the plane the driver was not using.  Those views are now taken per call, as the radiation driver's are; the capture records an exact digest of every input, and a replay reports the first input and step that differ from the captured run.
disposition: recaptured as p26-cloud-capture4; replayed as p26-cloud-replay4 (both blocks), p26-cloud-replay4-macro and p26-cloud-replay4-micro (one block each)
